title: Sensing EDU
description: Application-layer TM of a sensing EDU, composed with CityLink Platform and Embedded Core TMs. It receives zone CRI and issuedAt through configure and updatePriority. Firmware emits priority per hazard factor, using CRI directly or incorporating local information such as HP. Its calculation is outside this model. Without a connection to the EMC the last contextual configuration may be outdated.

contextualRiskIndex.description: CRI currently applied, written by configure and updatePriority.

issuedAt.title: Issued at
issuedAt.description: issuedAt of the CRI currently applied; older assignments are discarded.

contextualPriority.title: Current priority per hazard factor
contextualPriority.description: Firmware may assign the same priority to different factors; no local hazard-perception calculation is required.

updatePriority.title: Update priority
updatePriority.description: Invoked by the EMC on every EDU of a zone whenever the CRI of that zone changes. The update is atomic; an assignment older than the one applied (by issuedAt) is discarded.
